Name: X Shore
Description: Actions speak louder than words. X Shore is a Swedish manufacturer of high-end electric craft. Our mission: revolutionise the maritime industry with the power of silence. Our vision: Redefining mobility. Experience the Power of Silence with X Shore - driving the future of electric boating.

Name: SaltX Technology
Description: SaltX is a Swedish Greentech company that develops and markets sustainable technology that will benefit customers, the climate, and society. The company operates within the electrification of emission-intensive industries such as the lime and cement industries. SaltX Technology's share is listed on the Nasdaq First North Premier Growth Market.

Name: Dürr CTS - Clean Technology Systems
Description:
At Dürr CTS, we unite global reach with local expertise to deliver customized environmental solutions for the industrial sector. 

Formerly the Clean Technology Systems division of the Dürr Group, we have been operating as an independent company since November 2025. Same Team, Same Excellence means our clients still rely on the same trusted experts who have been delivering high-quality air pollution control and noise abatement technologies for decades.

We’re committed to staying close to our customers worldwide, offering not only innovative and sustainable technologies but also reliable solutions that ensure environmental compliance and operational safety. 

Follow us on LinkedIn to discover how we're shaping the future of clean technology with a personal touch.

Name: Your Beet
Description: Social Commerce platforms for food - converting influencer recipes to shopped grocery baskets, and leading the global shift towards more modern, healthy and sustainable food system.

Name: Medclair AB
Description:
Medclair, founded in 2013, is a Swedish Research and Development company with leading-edge expertise in in measurement, collection, and destruction of nitrous oxide (N2O). We solve healthcare and environmental challenges through innovation.

We have developed a number of patents within catalytic gas purification and collection, around which we have developed a stable, energy-efficient process. Our customers are healthcare and dental care facilities that demand a climate-smart use of nitrous oxide for pain relief. 

Nitrous oxide is a gas used in the healthcare industry due to its analgesic and anxiolytic properties, which offer significant benefits. However, improper collection and purification of nitrous oxide can have negative impacts on both the environment and the health of the individuals responsible for its administration.

We are members of the Swedish Medtech organisation, Swecare, and the Nordic Centre for Sustainable Healthcare.

Name: Meadow
Description:
Meadow is built on a simple but powerful belief: circularity should feel effortless. 
We create technologies that help global brands reduce environmental impact without compromising on beauty, function or experience. By innovating from within existing industrial ecosystems, we enable suppliers to adopt better solutions at scale. 
Meadow’s technology can be found in consumer goods across the globe, proving that sustainable transformation can be both practical and deeply enjoyable.

Name: Acetec AB
Description: Our business includes development and production of products for air, climate, and energy technology such as dehumidifies, air purifiers, ozone generators and air handling units that fully meet the strictest demands for quality and environmental awareness on the market, with industry experience dating from 1988.

Name: Direct Carbon
Description:
At Direct Carbon, we aim to improve indoor climates while using minimal energy. With a team of experienced professionals who are passionate about the environment and sustainability, we are committed to developing innovative solutions that can help address the challenges of indoor air quality and carbon capture. By leveraging cutting-edge technology and expertise, we are well-positioned to make a significant contribution to the fight against climate change.

Founded in 2021, Direct Carbon is a spin-off of Sally-R created to achieve a net zero planet, using carbon capture technology. Our compact, modular, and cost-efficient direct air capture technology (DAC) captures CO2 from the air using our efficient adsorbent while taking in air from the greenhouse, enriched with CO2, and pumping it back to the greenhouse for plant fertilization.

Name: AirZyme
Description:
AirZyme is developing next-generation carbon capture technologies using biocatalytic solutions. We’re focused on turning scientific breakthroughs into scalable systems that remove CO2 emissions from both industrial sources and directly from the air. Our vertically integrated platform covers the entire process, from biocatalyst development to commercial deployment, operating at the intersection of biotechnology, materials science, and industrial process engineering. 
Backed by the Swedish Innovation Agency Vinnova, the Dutch foundation CarbonFix, and the Swedish Energy Agency, we are currently piloting our biocatalyst with Stockholm Exergi, which is building a BECCS facility that will remove 800,000 tonnes of biogenic CO2 per year, and with Capsol Technologies, as our technology moves from lab-proven to field-tested, with commercial deployment in view.

Name: Sonicflora
Description:
At Sonicflora, we capture the unheard — ultrasonic signals from plants — and turn them into actionable insights. By combining AI, machine learning, and one of the most comprehensive plant sound datasets in agriculture, we enable early detection of stress and pests, optimize yields, and reduce resource use. 

Our vision is to set a new global standard for plant health monitoring, empowering agriculture to be more sustainable, resilient, and data-driven.

Name: FARMWISE Project EU
Description: FARMWISE project will transform the EU agricultural sector by empowering farmers and decision-makers with a state-of-the-art decision support system, combining precision agriculture, AI, and RS. FARMWISE provides new insights into water quality, quantity, soil health, and nutrient management. Its state-of-the-art framework fosters knowledge sharing between scientists, farmers, and policymakers in a co-creation environment (Systems Thinking). It consolidates existing collaborations and promotes new long-term cooperations between European organisations, including Water4All and Water Europe. The project will develop improved tools based on AI for more efficient European water policy and decision-making founded on research-based technologies to solve the most burning water pollution and climate change problems. For this purpose, the consortium brings together the best European water, agricultural, climate, and AI researchers to handle the sustainability of water resources, the natural environment, and efficient agriculture in the highly diverse European landscape in view of present and future climate change. FARMWISE evaluates, monitors, and implements gender and diversity balance in the consortium during the planned activities.

Name: FutureLab & Partners
Description:
Accelerate emerging technologies, and facilitate industries & brands shift into sustainable and value creating systems.

FutureLab & Partners collaborates with a close network of partners; institutes, new tech, industries, and non-competing brands. The shared ambition is to accelerate the shift from yesterday’s non-renewable and linear systems into the future circular and value-generating systems by collaborating with the right partners today. The FutureLab model shares risk and reward with its partners by investing time, resources, and capital.

Name: Power2Earth
Description: The partners behind Power2Earth – a joint initiative by Fertiberia, Lantmännen and Nordion Energi – have decided to discontinue the project.

Name: CarbGen
Description:
CarbGen is transforming industrial decarbonization with our unique Carbon Direct Conversion (CDC) method, an innovative electrolysis-based technology that captures and converts CO2 directly from flue gas into sustainable feedstocks like methanol. 

By eliminating the need for hydrogen gas, our solution significantly improves energy efficiency and simplifies on-site implementation, making decarbonization more practical and cost-effective. 

Join us in our mission to decarbonize hard-to-abate industries - one piece at a time.

Name: ecodrop
Description:
At our company, we are pioneering a sustainable future by transforming the way people perceive and manage their water consumption. Guided by the conviction that awareness is the first step towards conservation, we have developed a groundbreaking solution to drive this change.

Our innovative product, EcoDrop, couples a cutting-edge water meter with a powerful, user-friendly app. This dynamic duo gives users access to real-time data on their water consumption, empowering them to make informed decisions that lead to sustainable water usage habits.

EcoDrop's water meter, with its unique self-generating power mechanism, seamlessly integrates with faucets and showers in your home. When combined with the EcoDrop app, it provides a comprehensive understanding of water usage, fostering efficient and sustainable water practices.

But our mission doesn't stop at product innovation. We're staunch advocates for water conservation and are devoted to making a measurable difference in creating a sustainable future.

Embark on this journey with us and help shape a more conscious and sustainable world.

Name: ECOBARGE GROUP AB
Description:
ECOBARGE turns farm waste into climate-positive value.
ECOBARGE is a Swedish innovation company with a modular, mobile systems convert agricultural biomass into biochar, bio-oil, and syngas while capturing carbon at the source. Built for a volatile future, Ecobarge empowers farms to reduce emissions, improve soil health, and generate new revenue streams—turning waste into an asset for farmers and the climate.

Name: SunWave Sweden
Description:
Experience the future of heating technology with patented IR heating panels made from 100% organic materials. Designed for beauty, built for performance—SunWave delivers safe, efficient, and sustainable warmth to every room.

SunWave IR panels harness the natural power of far-infrared rays—just like the sun—to warm walls, bodies, and objects directly, not the air. With up to 80% energy savings, zero emissions, and zero noise, our IR heating technology redefines comfort and efficiency in any space.

Key Features:

- 100% organic technology

- Zero CO2 emissions during use

- 5-year warranty

- CE, ISO, DEKRA, Fraunhofer certified

- Silent & Smart operation

Name: Xodor AB
Description:
Xodor develops passive filtration solutions for floor drains, sink drains and ventilation systems.

Our products, including DryDrain and PCF Pipe, use Sorbonite, a calcium silicate with a naturally high pH value above 11.

The patented odor removal technology helps reduce bacteria, fungi and odors without chemicals, moving parts or additional maintenance.

Based in Uppsala, Sweden.

Name: Klimatinstallationer i Östergötland AB
Description: Installation, service och rådgivning av klimatprodukter

Name: Aerbon
Description: Aerbon is a company developing direct air capture technology. Based on research from KTH Royal Institute of Technology, we have designed a system that can use up 80% of the total energy demand from waste heat resulting in low capture costs.

Name: Zeotech AB
Description:
Air purification for a sustainable industry. 
CLEANTECH - Care-free industrial air purification system with high availabilty, lower operating cost, recycling, energy optimization and lower CO2 footprint has been  our core business for almost 30 years.

Name: Svensk vätgasutveckling
Description: As a hydrogen consultancy company, we focus on supporting green hydrogen technologies development. We offer a range of services to our clients, including project management, development projects, and innovation development. Overall, we aim to support the growth of the green hydrogen industry by providing our clients with the know-how and expertise they need to succeed in this exciting and rapidly evolving field.

Name: Electrostatic Filters International AB / Elektrostatiska filter
Description:
Electrostatic Filters International AB is a company that contributes to an improved environment both indoors and outdoors. We work to improve the air we breathe through both purification and reduced environmental impact, the latter through reduced energy consumption and reduced mountains of rubbish.
The owner is Harry Kraaijenhagen, with solid experience in the ventilation industry since 1984.

The core business for EFI AB is marketing, product sales and project activities in air improvement. The product flora mainly consists of electrostatic filters, ionization equipment and monitoring equipment for air improvement.
The project activities include preliminary studies, measurement and control of air quality, which is a natural complement to the sale of equipment.

EFI AB will primarily cooperate with retailers and direct sales. EFI AB Works to actively create a stable foundation for its partners regarding both products and support.
The slogan for the business is "The air we breathe". EFI AB works to create good air quality both indoors and outdoors. Through active electrostatic filters, energy consumption in ventilation units is reduced. By converting to an electrostatic filter, you contribute to reducing the CO2 impact because the need to change filters is no longer needed, which reduces the mountain of garbage.

Name: PTL Sverige
Description: Vi på PTL är stolta över att ta en aktiv roll i Sveriges och EU:s gröna omställning genom etableringen av en toppmodern anodfabrik värd 13 miljarder SEK vid Torsboda Industrial Park utanför Timrå. Fabriken kommer att vara en viktig del för att ytterligare stärka Sveriges ledande position inom batteritillverkning genom att leverera anodmaterial till den svenska batteritillverkaren Northvolt. Tillsammans kommer vi att skapa cirka 1 900 arbetstillfällen och bidra till utvecklingen i regionen.

Name: Reddo Floor Solutions AB
Description: Reddo utvecklar skalbara och patenterade innovationer för nya effektiva klimatsmarta metoder och produkter för att torka, sanera och återställa vattenskador via återbruk, med 70-95% lägre koldioxidbelastning kontra dagens arbetssätt.

Name: Carbon-ive
Description:
Carbon-ive | Rethinking Digital Responsibility

Carbon-ive is on a mission to make digital habits more sustainable. We combine innovation, awareness, and technology to reduce carbon emissions linked to AI usage — while rewarding conscious choices.

Join us in building a smarter, greener future.

Name: PanelPlanner
Description:
Transforming Solar Installations with Next-Generation Planning Tools
Streamline sales, planning, and customer relations with our powerful 3D platform for solar panel projects.

Name: SIBE International AB
Description:
SIBE International AB har sedan 1972 varit verksamma inom aktuellt område och är specialister på all teknik för LUFTBEFUKTNING, EVAPORATIV KYLNING, VATTENRENING och AVFUKTNING. Med helheten och systemets livscykel i fokus, skapas energi- och vatteneffektiva funktionslösningar för miljövänlig luftbefuktning, evaporativ kylning, vattenrening och avfuktning, där olika mervärden adderas för slutanvändaren. SIBE är också den enda leverantören i Sverige med ett komplett teknikspektrum inom dessa områden, med egna funktionslösningar och konstruktioner. Detta säkerställer att systemlösningarna alltid kan optimeras, dimensioneras och anpassas efter aktuella förutsättningar, med rätt teknik, för rätt applikation.

Företagets hemmamarknad är Norden, där SIBE finns representerade med egna kontor i regionerna Stockholm – Vimmerby – Göteborg. Företaget exporterar också system till återförsäljare och slutanvändare i ett flertal länder i och utanför Europa.

SIBE erbjuder funktionslösningar med kundens förutsättningar och helheten i fokus. Med mer än 50 år i branschen och ett komplett teknikspektrum, har företaget idag hög kompetens och lång erfarenhet från snart alla tänkbara applikationsområden. Allt ifrån traditionella områden som träindustrier och tryckerier, till offentliga lokaler, sjukhus, museer, utvecklingslabb, försvars-, livsmedels- läkemedels-, fordons- och olika typer av processindustrier m.fl.

SIBE erbjuder, utöver sina egna system, även serviceavtal, akutservice, förbrukningsmaterial samt reservdelar till alla förekommande fabrikat av system för luftbefuktning, evaporativ kylning, vattenrening och avfuktning. 

För ytterligare information besök gärna vår hemsida på SIBE.SE

Name: Jora Future
Description: Together, healing the planet. We reduce CO2 in the atmosphere by sequestering carbon from biowaste.

Name: Arctic Business Collab
Description:
Collab Composite is an innovation platform powered by Arctic Business that connects forward-thinking startups with leading industry players to accelerate sustainable innovation. 

Based in Northern Sweden, Collab fosters co-creation between entrepreneurs, researchers, and companies like Saab and Hitachi Energy to solve real industrial challenges. Through mentorship, funding access, and cutting-edge test environments, we drive global innovation from a local hub.
